subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` as an `after_compaction` plugin contract, including automatic session rotation after terminal tool-loop overflow?
rationale: This adds a new plugin capability and changes session-continuity behavior; code review can validate mechanics but cannot choose the permanent public contract or whether unconditional overflow recovery should ship with it.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow hook API
options.body: Accept the current-session-only deferred API after repairing harness identity, documenting availability, separating or explicitly approving overflow auto-reset, and adding exact-head proof.

options.title: Use a declarative hook result
options.body: Have `after_compaction` return a typed reset request that the lifecycle owner interprets, avoiding exposure of a raw callback through harness parameters.

options.title: Decline the core capability
options.body: Keep session reset controlled by existing user and gateway flows and move plugin-specific compaction recovery outside this core PR.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Accept the current-session-only deferred API after repairing harness identity, documenting availability, separating or explicitly approving overflow auto-reset, and adding exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the pluggable harness architecture, plugin contract, and gateway session lifecycle introduced or recently maintained in this area.
